headline: President Bush changed two earlier executive orders, 13389 and 13390, which dealt with federal coordination of Gulf Coast hurricane recovery.
what_it_does: This order amends two earlier executive orders, numbers 13389 and 13390. Those orders, from 2005, set up a federal coordinator and office to manage rebuilding after Hurricane Katrina and other Gulf Coast hurricanes. No summary was provided, so the specific changes made by this order are not described here.
